summary: The ClearData file contains server-side VBScript code that sets various HTTP response properties such as buffering and expiration. It defines a screen name variable and includes an external ASP file for additional processing.
purpose: To set up and manage HTTP response properties and process the ClearData screen using additional logic from an included ASP file.

workflows.name: ClearData Screen Processing
steps: Set response buffering and expiration properties.
Assign 'ClearData' to a screen name variable.
Include external ASP logic for further processing.

system_behavior: The system sets the response to buffer and prevents caching by setting expiration to -1.
Utilizes the 'strScreenName' variable in subsequent scripts or processes.
